title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #13 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah is number 112 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Falaq
   D. Al-Ikhlas

2. What does the verse "Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Read in the name of your Lord
   B. Allah is the Most Great
   C. Say: Allah is One
   D. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help

3. What is a chapter of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. A rak'ah
   B. An ayah
   C. A sujud
   D. A surah

4. Which is an example of copying the Prophet's kindness? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   B. Refusing to greet people
   C. Hiding a friend's book
   D. Teasing a friend

5. What does "akhlaq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Character and manners
   C. Prayer times
   D. Direction of prayer

6. What did the Prophet do if he did not like a food? (1 mark)
   A. Complained loudly
   B. Threw it away
   C. Insulted the cook
   D. Left it quietly without criticising

7. What is the meaning of "adab of eating"? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. The etiquette or good manners of eating
   C. A type of food
   D. A fast

8. Which of these is a benefit of clean teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Fresh breath
   B. Toothache
   C. Bad breath
   D. More cavities

9. The Kiswahili word for the tooth-cleaning stick or brush is (1 mark)
   A. Kanzu
   B. Mswaki
   C. Mkeka
   D. Kofia

10. A game is permitted in Islam if (1 mark)
   A. It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   B. It involves betting
   C. It uses bad words
   D. It hurts people

11. What should you do when the adhan is called during a game? (1 mark)
   A. Turn off the radio
   B. Stop, make wudhu and pray
   C. Continue the game
   D. Ask for extra time

12. Which name of Allah is in every "Bismillah" along with Ar-Rahim? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Basir
   B. Al-Malik
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. As-Salam

13. What is our response to Allah's mercy? (1 mark)
   A. Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   B. Ignore others
   C. Be harsh
   D. Be proud

14. Ar-Rahman's mercy is (1 mark)
   A. Only for Muslims in Kenya
   B. For all creation
   C. Only for adults
   D. Only for the rich

15. How should we describe Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Like a king on earth
   B. Like a big man
   C. Nothing is like Him
   D. Like an angel

16. Why should belief in Raqib and Atid help us behave well? (1 mark)
   A. They laugh at us
   B. Our words and actions are recorded
   C. They give sweets
   D. They punish us at once

17. Which of these is NOT an angel duty? (1 mark)
   A. Making rain by their own power
   B. Bringing revelation by Allah's order
   C. Taking souls by permission
   D. Recording deeds

18. How many prophets are named in the Qur'an, as taught at Grade 4? (1 mark)
   A. Ninety-nine
   B. Forty
   C. Twenty-five
   D. Twelve

19. What is the meaning of generosity? (1 mark)
   A. Boasting
   B. Giving freely without expecting anything back
   C. Refusing to share
   D. Keeping everything

20. Who was the brother who helped Prophet Musa? (1 mark)
   A. Yahya
   B. Ilyas
   C. Harun
   D. Idris

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how a Grade 4 child can practise honesty, generosity, patience and obedience. (4 marks)

22. Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals". (3 marks)

23. Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour. (5 marks)

24. State three times when the siwak or toothbrush is recommended. (3 marks)

25. Describe what the Prophet (S.A.W.) did every night before sleeping with Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas. (3 marks)

26. Why are Al-Falaq and An-Naas called the two surahs of seeking refuge? (3 marks)

27. Explain why Muslims should not waste food and give two ways of avoiding waste. (4 marks)

28. Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy. (2 marks)

29. Write the names of prophets in the family chain from Ibrahim to Yusuf. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Al-Ikhlas
   Al-Ikhlas is surah 112, Al-Falaq 113 and An-Naas 114.

2. D — You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help
   This is the fifth verse of Al-Fatiha.

3. D — A surah
   A surah is a chapter made of ayat.

4. A — Sharing your lunch with a classmate
   Kindness means caring for others.

5. B — Character and manners
   Akhlaq means moral character.

6. D — Left it quietly without criticising
   He never criticised food.

7. B — The etiquette or good manners of eating
   Adab means manners.

8. A — Fresh breath
   Clean teeth give fresh breath.

9. B — Mswaki
   Mswaki means toothbrush or chewing stick.

10. A — It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer
   These are the conditions.

11. B — Stop, make wudhu and pray
   Prayer must not be delayed by play.

12. C — Ar-Rahman
   Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim contains both names.

13. A — Be merciful to people, animals and the environment
   Mercy received should be shown.

14. B — For all creation
   It covers believers and non-believers, people and animals.

15. C — Nothing is like Him
   Allah is not compared to His creation.

16. B — Our words and actions are recorded
   We try to speak and do good.

17. A — Making rain by their own power
   Angels act only by Allah's command.

18. C — Twenty-five
   Muslims learn twenty-five names.

19. B — Giving freely without expecting anything back
   Generous people give willingly.

20. C — Harun
   Harun was Musa's brother and helper.

SECTION B
----
21. (4 marks)
   Answer: Honesty: return lost items; generosity: share lunch; patience: wait calmly for a turn; obedience: come when parents call.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each virtue with a suitable action.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before wudhu and prayer, on waking up, when the mouth smells, before sleeping.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct time.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: He joined his hands, blew into them, recited the three surahs and wiped his body with his hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for blowing into the hands, 1 mark for the three surahs, 1 mark for wiping the body.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both begin with "Qul a'udhu", meaning "Say: I seek refuge". In them we ask Allah to protect us from harm.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the opening words, 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for protection.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah does not love the wasteful. Take only what you can finish, and share leftovers while fresh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reason, 1 mark for Qur'an 7:31 or Allah's dislike, 2 marks for two ways.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Ibrahim, 1 for Ishaq and Yaqub, 1 for Yusuf in the right order.
